description: A newly created PostgreSQL 17 Alpine container replayed the complete production migration chain and executed the locked 32-row E03 matrix through four loopback HTTP authorization surfaces.
isolation: Disposable Docker container zhudatuan-e03-1daaf663f3c047bc; synthetic E03 Principal, Membership, NodeContext, order, Outbox and task rows only; the container was removed after execution.
production_impact: None. No production service, database, domain, deployment channel, customer record or external Provider was contacted.
differences_from_production: Local disposable Docker PostgreSQL rather than managed Alibaba Cloud PostgreSQL.
Synthetic resolver-backed Principal, Membership and NodeContext fixtures rather than public Session and Membership ingress.
Page, API, task and service were isolated loopback HTTP probe routes around the production AccessPipeline, not deployed customer-facing adapters or real traffic.
The service Provider was deterministic and in-process; no real external Provider was contacted.
No stable separately managed staging execution and no production observation.

runtime.postgres: PostgreSQL 17.11 on aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit
